claim_boundary: research validation plan; proposed thresholds are internal project gates, not certification standards

milestones.name: Self-contained evidence and provenance
deliverables: bundle_manifest.json with SHA-256 for every file
source packet or immutable retrievable URI and hash
raw telemetry and scenario problem for every plotted mission
software commit, build metadata, dependency lock, reproduce script
metric dictionary and score formula
exit_criteria: 100% packaged files referenced and hashed
100% referenced files present or retrievable by immutable hash
reproduction run regenerates every reported scalar within declared tolerance
no absolute local paths
no stale or unreferenced outputs

milestones.name: Metric semantics and honest scoring
deliverables: formal definitions for route error, cross-track, along-track, closure, continuity, envelope margin and score
separate pass/fail gates from optional summary score
commanded path and target-transition event log
exit_criteria: score is monotonic with terminal and integrated tracking error
a case at 75% of an allowed miss limit cannot receive approximately 100/100
every metric names frame, units, sampling rule and event exclusions
manifest values exactly match plotted time-series statistics

milestones.name: Source-evaluator differential parity
deliverables: B747 comparison at all NASA anchor conditions plus randomized local samples
X8 comparison throughout declared alpha/beta/rate/control/throttle region
Hummingbird six-axis wrench comparison against RotorPy
X-15 coefficient and propulsion comparison against selected source model
exit_criteria: exact-code transcodes agree near floating-point precision
digitized-source differences remain within documented digitization uncertainty
worst-case state and error are published
no unexplained sign, frame or normalization mismatch

milestones.name: Golden equilibrium plants
deliverables: one source-anchored trim or hover case per family
six-axis force and moment decomposition
table and actuator margins
direct independent equation-closure history
exit_criteria: translational trim acceleration norm <= 0.01 m/s^2 for fixed-wing and <= 0.02 m/s^2 for multirotor
angular acceleration norm <= 0.001 rad/s^2
no extrapolation or clamping
minimum table margin >= 10% of each active axis span
no actuator saturation
hold duration: B747 120 s, X8 60 s, Hummingbird 30 s, X-15 60-120 s source segment

milestones.name: Independent convergence and closure
deliverables: RK4 dt, dt/2 and dt/4 runs
adaptive DOP853 reference
full-history position, velocity, attitude and body-rate errors
observed order on smooth intervals
exit_criteria: final position difference dt/2 vs dt/4 <= 1 m for B747/X-15 and <= 0.1 m for X8/Hummingbird
final velocity difference <= 0.01 m/s
attitude geodesic difference <= 0.001 rad
closure residual decreases consistently with step size where finite differencing is used
events are excluded or evaluated one-sided

milestones.name: Inner-loop controller baselines
deliverables: body-rate step and doublet tests
attitude step tests
commanded and achieved actuator histories
linearized model, poles, controllability and margins
exit_criteria: all commanded axes stable
overshoot <= 20% unless source requirement differs
steady-state error <= 2% of command
no sustained saturation
nonlinear small-signal responses agree with linear model within declared tolerance
gain/phase or disk margins meet predeclared internal requirements

milestones.name: Complete family-appropriate missions
deliverables: B747 trim-climb-turn-descend-capture mission
X8 powered trim, rectangle and return-to-trim mission
Hummingbird takeoff-hover-square-yaw-return-land mission
X-15 source-trim/doublet/energy-management/valid-termination mission
exit_criteria: all declared waypoints captured in order
endpoint position, velocity and attitude inside explicit corridor
cross-track RMS and maximum below mission-specific limits
speed/altitude tracking within mission-specific limits
no undeclared state discontinuity
no envelope violation or prolonged actuator saturation
mission-completion event reached rather than merely timing out

milestones.name: 3-DOF / reduced / 6-DOF parity
deliverables: same plant, environment, propulsion, mass, controls and initial physical state at all tiers
constrained 6-DOF reduction test
initial-derivative and full-trajectory differences
exit_criteria: initial Vdot, hdot, gamma-dot and course-dot agree within declared numerical tolerance
constrained 6-DOF and 3-DOF histories agree to convergence tolerance
free 6-DOF divergence is explained by measured attitude/rate/actuator effects
scenario-contract hash differs only by dynamics tier

milestones.name: Robustness and Monte Carlo
deliverables: predeclared distributions for wind, mass, inertia, CG, aero, propulsion, sensors and actuators
fixed seeds and all failure artifacts
pass-rate confidence intervals and failure taxonomy
exit_criteria: at least 100 physically distinct runs per family for development and 1000 for release evidence
pass-rate lower confidence bound meets predeclared target
no duplicated perturbation cases
all failures classified as envelope, numerical, controller, actuator, sensor or mission

milestones.name: Independent source maneuver validation
deliverables: replay of published trim, doublet, mode or flight-test maneuver
time-aligned state/control comparison
uncertainty-aware error report
exit_criteria: responses lie within published measurement/model uncertainty where available
mode frequency and damping agree within source-informed limits
no tuning against the held-out validation maneuver
validation data and calibration data are separated

milestones.name: Release flag and claim matrix
deliverables: claim-by-claim evidence matrix
green/yellow/red status with immutable artifact links
limitations and invalid-use statement
exit_criteria: every green claim has independent source parity, convergence, closure and mission evidence
no global-envelope or certification claim is made from local surrogate evidence
all release artifacts are reproducible and self-contained
